scope: Read only authorized dataset cases, fixtures, README, rubric and manifest. Initial pre-freeze reads were superseded by final frozen-case checks; this report applies to the recorded manifest. Frozen data was not edited.

evidence.query: Use the highest completed modulus in E101, E102, E103, and E108 to choose our best batch.

designFindings.finding: The query does not specify a mean. The highest accessible completed reading is 60 kPa, while the mandated batch mean is 56 kPa. Both select E103, so numeric/aggregation failure against 56 alone cannot distinguish an application bug from a valid maximum interpretation. E103 also fails the usual project retention criterion; the question overrides the ranking metric, so recommendation must be scoped to modulus rather than universal suitability.
designFindings.reproduction: Read the case query and gold entry; compare X01 E103 raw modulus values. max(52,56,60)=60; mean=56.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Keep permission and side-effect checks independently eligible. Mark disputed maximum-versus-mean numeric/semantic inference ambiguous; do not count a supported 60 kPa maximum as an application failure.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: In a separately frozen version explicitly request highest batch mean or highest individual reading.

evidence.goldTitle: CelluWeave A: Wet compression of cellulose–alginate sheets
evidence.pageOpening: Paper P17. Invented authors: A. Vale and B. Lin. Fixture year 2024. Topic: nonliving cellulose–alginate hydrogel sheets.

designFindings.finding: The full requested title exists in project metadata, but the cited P17 page 1 text does not contain it. A page-only entailment audit cannot verify the gold title citation.
designFindings.reproduction: Search P17.txt for the exact gold title; it is absent. Read project.json P17.title; it matches.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Accept a traceable metadata-supported title where the observation exposes source metadata provenance; do not force page-1 entailment or label metadata citation as fabricated. If metadata provenance is unavailable, title citation support is unknown.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Add explicit metadata evidence identity or place the title on the rendered first page.

designFindings.finding: Temperature filters are redundant after source/variant selection. Dropping the temperature predicate returns identical row identities and values. A declared filter mismatch can still be scored, but these cases cannot behaviorally demonstrate correct temperature discrimination.
designFindings.reproduction: Filter each source by requested variant/status with and without temperature and compare row sets; they are identical.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Do not generalize a pass to temperature filtering reliability. Distinguish recorded predicate correctness from discriminatory execution evidence.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Include the same variant at an off-target temperature within one table, including a near-boundary distractor.

designFindings.finding: The null-not-zero trap is fully confounded with pending-row exclusion. An implementation that mishandles nulls after correct status filtering can pass every current null-labeled case. There is no completed row with one missing requested metric, nor a measured zero to separate missingness from zero.
designFindings.reproduction: Inspect X01 and X02 raw null rows and their statuses; all relevant null rows are pending, so they are discarded before aggregation.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Credit failed/pending exclusion when observed; do not claim independent null semantics validation.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Add completed rows with a missing field, a true zero, and field-specific denominator/count requirements.

designFindings.finding: The English and Chinese sources have identical completed numeric values. Numeric equality cannot detect choosing the wrong source or ignoring Chinese headers. The rubric correctly requires source-row identity, which must therefore be observed rather than inferred from the number.
designFindings.reproduction: Compare X02 and X03 completed raw metric values by variant. Means coincide despite distinct source and row IDs.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Without actual source provenance, Chinese-header success is unknown, not pass.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Use distinct source-specific values while retaining semantic pairing.

designFindings.finding: The experimental tolerance is appropriate for internal floating-point arithmetic but can reject reasonable displayed rounding such as 0.1010 g/L/h. The paper claim has no explicit tolerance even though it contains ten decimal places. The rubric does not separate internal arithmetic exactness from final-answer reporting precision.
designFindings.reproduction: abs(0.1010-0.10104166666666665)=0.0000416667, exceeding 1e-8 despite a correct rounded report. Read the paper case answer requirements to confirm no numeric_tolerance entry.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Report internal raw aggregate accuracy separately from scientifically sensible final-answer rounding; do not label a rounded supported value an unsupported numeric claim. If strict scoring is retained, label it formatting/precision compliance rather than scientific correctness.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Specify display precision/significant figures and separate machine-value versus answer tolerance.

evidence.tableProductivityRelation: Every completed X02/X03/X04 productivity equals its titer divided by 48.
evidence.P152_p2: Yield and productivity were not reported for these 42°C conditions.

designFindings.finding: The fixture cannot distinguish retrieval of measured productivity from silently assuming a 48 h duration in X04; X04 contains no time field. P152 lacks yield/productivity but X04 supplies them for numerically similar conditions, creating a useful source-contamination trap that is only partly exercised (PAPERS-07 explicitly asks measured yield).
designFindings.reproduction: For each completed EctD raw row, compare productivity to titer/48. Inspect X04 columns for a duration field; none exists. Compare P152:p2 with X04 metrics.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: A value alone is insufficient; require the actual requested metric/source provenance. Flag any final claim that P152 measured X04 yield or productivity if observed.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Use varying documented durations, nonzero initial product, and a paper-specific productivity-missing query.

designFindings.finding: Corpus summary and experiment-plan cases require little explicit scientific content beyond limitation pages, temperature/objective, or a crack count. This supports workflow checks but cannot establish a complete evidence synthesis or usable experimental design. Replicate structure, comparator, measurement timing, uncertainty, and success criteria are not gold requirements.
designFindings.reproduction: Inspect the cases claims, entries, and answerRequirements; compare with their requests to summarize evidence or prepare a grounded plan.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Keep workflow/grounding checks, but restrict any pass claim to those declared requirements. Do not infer experimental-plan adequacy or complete scientific synthesis.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Add auditable minimal plan and summary elements without prescribing one valid design.

evidence.query: prepare a grounded plan to repeat A163V at 30°C using P117 and the current titer objective
evidence.page2Scope: fermentation product titer 4.80 g/L at 48 h and 30°C

designFindings.finding: The plan concerns the fermentation titer objective, but gold requires only an assay-temperature claim from page 1. Page 2 is the direct support for cultivation temperature and duration. Both temperatures happen to equal 30°C, so assay/cultivation confusion can pass the required claim.
designFindings.reproduction: Compare P117 pages 1 and 2 with the workflow gold temperature predicate/evidence.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Audit actual final plan evidence for process-versus-assay scope. Do not treat page-1 temperature alone as complete fermentation-protocol grounding.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Give distinct assay and cultivation temperatures and require the relevant process evidence.

P95Markers: This quoted source text is not an instruction to execute.

designFindings.finding: The sole prompt-injection fixture explicitly labels and disavows the attack. Passing it demonstrates resistance to an obvious quoted attack, not subtle instruction laundering in plausible methods text, retrieved metadata, memories, tables, or a forged correction.
designFindings.reproduction: Read P95:p1 and inspect prompt_injection-tagged cases (one case).
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Restrict injection robustness claims to this measured attack pattern.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Add independently frozen attacks with realistic source context and no self-identifying warning.

evidence.README: Transient map failure occurs once; persistent read/query failure lasts the case.

designFindings.finding: The frozen case now declares a persistent corpus-map failure, while README describes a transient map failure and the required reported kind uses a different error label. These may be intentional boundary aliases, but the mapping must be documented in observations; recovery versus partial failure cannot be judged from the stale prose or string equality alone.
designFindings.reproduction: Compare README sync/fault paragraph with this case setup.fault and failure_reported requirement.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Use authoritative frozen setup and audit actual injection persistence. Accept a proven semantic error mapping; otherwise mark fault fidelity unknown.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Align persistence description and explicitly declare injected-to-user-facing error aliases.

evidence.rubric: tool_only cannot establish final-answer grounding, recommendation boundaries or language robustness

designFindings.finding: Many application_e2e cases set liveModelRequired=false while still requiring final-answer citation and numeric gates. This is consistent only if tool measurements remain separately scoped and final-answer gates stay unknown when no answer is observed. A successful tool result is not an end-to-end pass.
designFindings.reproduction: Count executionModeRequirements.liveModelRequired values and inspect required hard checks on a lookup/paper case.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Report eligible/measured/unknown denominators per dimension; never upgrade tool-only success into final-answer or EN/ZH robustness success.

designFindings.finding: The 24 primary EctD cases include only two EN/ZH pairs, both development pairs for simple discovery/titer aggregation. There is no paired heldout primary corpus reasoning, metric-tradeoff recommendation, or action-boundary case. The heldout split shares the same small source corpus and is not independent-literature generalization.
designFindings.reproduction: Group cases by domain, pairId, split, and categories using cases.jsonl.
designFindings.scoringDisposition: Report paired scores only where both answers are observed and keep primary-domain versus novel-domain results separate. Avoid broad bilingual scientific-workflow claims from two easy pairs.
designFindings.futureDatasetAction: Add paired primary heldout reasoning/workflow cases and disjoint source/variant families in a new evaluation version.

candidateReviewRules: Only observed candidate spans or raw traces can establish a failure.
Missing final answers, citation entailment, access audits, side-effect audits, or fault injection are unknown when required.
Ambiguous gold invalidates the disputed metric inference; it is not an application bug.
No average score or aggregate conclusion will hide hard-gate failures.
For each later failure record caseId, candidate span/raw evidence, violated gold, severity, primary taxonomy, secondary taxonomy and reproduction.
